facts.text: Under the Uniquely Eureka Advantage, first-year students who follow all requirements and do not graduate in four years receive their fifth year of tuition free.

sources.title: The Uniquely Eureka Advantage: A Bold Commitment To Our Students

facts.text: Eureka College awards all new students a $2,000 Experiential Learning Grant to support internships, mentorships, research presentations, or study abroad.
